@@ -101,6 +101,79 @@ class Blueprint(SansioBlueprint):
             t.cast(str, self.static_folder), filename, max_age=max_age
         )
 
+    def register_blueprint(self, blueprint: Blueprint, **options: t.Any) -> None:
+        """Register a :class:`~flask.Blueprint` on this blueprint.
+
+        Keyword arguments passed to this method will override the defaults
+        set on the blueprint.
+        """
+        # Preserve the child blueprint's instance url_prefix by merging it
+        # into the options dict so it is not lost during deferred registration.
+        if blueprint.url_prefix is not None:
+            options.setdefault("url_prefix", blueprint.url_prefix)
+
+        self._blueprints.append((blueprint, options))
+
+    def register(self, app: t.Any, options: dict[str, t.Any]) -> None:
+        """Called by :meth:`Flask.register_blueprint` to register all
+        views and callbacks registered on the blueprint with the application.
+        """
+        import copy
+
+        first_registration = bool(options.get("first_registration", True))
+        first_name = options.get("name", self.name)
+        name = f"{first_name}.{self.name}" if not first_registration else self.name
+        opts = copy.copy(options)
+        opts["first_registration"] = first_registration
+        opts["name"] = name
+
+        state = self.make_setup_state(app, opts)
+        active = None
+
+        if self._got_registered_once:
+            active = state._blueprints.append(self)
+
+        self._got_registered_once = True
+
+        if active is not None:
+            active.__enter__()
+
+        for deferred in self.deferred_functions:
+            deferred(state)
+
+        cli_resolved_group = options.get("cli_group", self.cli_group)
+
+        if self.cli.commands:
+            if cli_resolved_group is None:
+                raise ValueError(
+                    "You must provide a name for the CLI group when registering"
+                    " a blueprint with CLI commands."
+                )
+
+            app.cli.add_command(cli_resolved_group, *self.cli.commands)
+
+        for blueprint, bp_options in self._blueprints:
+            bp_options = copy.copy(bp_options)
+            bp_url_prefix = bp_options.get("url_prefix")
+            parent_url_prefix = options.get("url_prefix")
+
+            if bp_url_prefix is None:
+                bp_url_prefix = parent_url_prefix
+            elif parent_url_prefix is not None:
+                bp_url_prefix = parent_url_prefix.rstrip("/") + "/" + bp_url_prefix.lstrip("/")
+
+            bp_options["url_prefix"] = bp_url_prefix
+            bp_options["name"] = f"{name}.{blueprint.name}"
+            blueprint.register(app, bp_options)
+
+        if url_defaults := options.get("url_defaults"):
+            app.url_default_functions.setdefault(name, []).append(
+                lambda values: values.update(url_defaults)
+            )
+
+        if active is not None:
+            active.__exit__(None, None, None)
+
